triage.summary: A sender calling itself Elon Giveaway promises 2 BTC within 24 hours if Alex first sends 0.05 BTC to supposedly verify his wallet.
triage.risk_reason: This cryptocurrency giveaway scam requests an upfront payment of 0.05 BTC under the pretext of wallet verification, promising 2 BTC in return.
